people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: He didn’t lay his hand on the nobles of the children of Israel. They saw God, and ate and drank.
translations.bsb: But God did not lay His hand on the nobles of Israel; they saw Him, and they ate and drank.
translations.kjv: And upon the nobles of the children of Israel he laid not his hand: also they saw God, and did eat and drink.
translations.asv: And upon the nobles of the children of Israel he laid not his hand: and they beheld God, and did eat and drink.
